observations_about_methodology_only.observation: The methodology requires immutable references but the execution instructions did not specify an acceptable fallback when authoritative artifacts are absent from the workspace.
The lifecycle relationship among Deviation Records, Failure Records, Failure Assessment, and Audit Conclusion is executable but would benefit from explicit ordering guidance.
The instruction to use definitions exactly is difficult to replay unless the definitions are packaged with content hashes or repository paths.
Artificial mapping disclosure was practical and improved reviewability, but the threshold separating artificial mapping from high-uncertainty natural mapping was not explicit in the execution inputs.
